pages.name: English: King's, 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 c6
pages.notes: Plan had a minority attack with b4 and a knight route e1-d3 with the king on e1; overview called the structure a reversed Slav. Rewritten around d4 or Nf3/...e4/Nd4 and ...d5.

pages.name: English: King's, 2.Nc3 d6 3.d4
pages.notes: Plan used O-O before Nf3 and Be2; overview mentioned a Pirc. Rewritten around ...Nd7/...Nc6, 3...exd4 4.Qxd4 Nc6 and 3...e4. Reviewer rejection (a castling claim that fails after ...Nc6 and Nxd8) removed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: King's, 2.Nc3 f5
pages.notes: Plan had ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and ...d5 called a Stonewall (Black's pawns are on e5 and f5). Rewritten.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.g3
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bb4 a pin (the d2-pawn shields the king) and the b-file open; plan had bxc3 before ...Bxc3. Rewritten.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.g3 Bxc3
pages.notes: Plan read c3 as a square move and claimed Black controls the light squares after giving up the dark-squared bishop. Rewritten around 4.bxc3 or 4.dxc3 and ...Na5 or ...b6/...Ba6 against c4.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.Nd5
pages.notes: Plan had an a4-b4 route against a bishop on a5. Rewritten around the bishop's retreats and ...c6 against the d5-knight.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.Nd5 a5
pages.notes: Overview said ...a5 secures a pin on a c3-knight that is on d5; plans had ...Bxc3 and an open a-file. Rewritten.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.Nd5 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan had White trapping the bishop and ...d5 with the knight on d5. Rewritten around b4 or e3 against ...Bc5 and ...c6.

pages.name: English: Kramnik-Shirov, 3.Nd5 Be7 4.d4
pages.notes: Plans had ...d5 onto the d5-knight and 0-0 notation. Rewritten around 4...exd4 5.Qxd4 Nc6 and ...d6. Reviewer rejections (5...Nc6 allows Qxg7, so ...Nf6 must come first) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Lukin Variation
pages.notes: Plans had a ...g5-g4 storm with queenside castling and an e6-pawn that does not exist. Rewritten around d4, g3/Bg2 and the e6-square. Reviewer rejection (a g2-bishop and Nd5 cannot reach e6) fixed and re-reviewed.
